# External datasets

These public datasets are **not redistributed** in this repository (see `.gitignore`).
Download each one and drop the CSV here to reproduce the applied examples.

| File | Dataset | Source |
|------|---------|--------|
| `bank_marketing.csv` | UCI Bank Marketing | https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/222/bank+marketing |
| `credit_default.csv` | UCI Default of Credit Card Clients | https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/350/default+of+credit+card+clients |
| `fremtpl2freq.csv` | French Motor TPL — freMTPL2freq | OpenML id 41214 (also R `CASdatasets`) |
